mu sync.RWMutex

// Atomic stats
stats struct {
    Hits, Misses, LoadErrors atomic.Int64

// Get with proper locking
func (c *Cache) Get(...) {
    c.mu.RLock()
    entry, ok := c.data[key]
    if ok && time.Now().Before(entry.ExpiresAt) && !entry.Loading {
        c.stats.Hits.Add(1)
        c.mu.RUnlock()
        return entry.Value, nil
    }
    c.mu.RUnlock()
    // ... upgrade to write lock for loading
}

// GetMulti with WaitGroup
func (c *Cache) GetMulti(...) map[string]interface{} {
    var wg sync.WaitGroup
    var mu sync.Mutex
    results := make(map[string]interface{})
    for _, key := range keys {

        go func(k string) {
            defer wg.Done()
            if v, err := c.Get(ctx, k); err == nil {
                mu.Lock()
                results[k] = v
                mu.Unlock()
            }

    return results
